name: Feasting Bite
body:
Feasting Bite (Ex)
Source Agents of Evil pg. 25
This rage power is available to half-orc barbarians. When the barbarian confirms a critical hit with her bite attack, she regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. The barbarian must have the bloody bite rage power and either the animal fury rage power or a natural bite attack before selecting this power. Activating this ability consumes 1 round of rage.
